effect_description_eng:
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[On Deletion] By trashing 1 card with [Etemon] or [Sukamon] in its name in your hand, return this card to the hand.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] When this Digimon would be deleted, by deleting 1 other Digimon with [Sukamon] in its name, prevent that deletion.
